provider.name: Integrated Digitized Biocollections
provider.organization_type: national biodiversity-collections aggregation, digitization, specimen-record, media, data-publishing, search, API, education, and cyberinfrastructure resource
provider.description: iDigBio is the U.S. national resource for Advancing Digitization of Biodiversity Collections. It aggregates specimen occurrence records, media, collection and publisher metadata, Darwin Core Archives, and related biodiversity data; provides portal search, maps, downloads, APIs, data-ingestion services, digitization and georeferencing resources, education, training, and community infrastructure.

purpose.summary: This file is a crawl-ready source catalog for collecting iDigBio documentation, portal and API guidance, specimen and media schemas, Darwin Core mappings, data publishing and ingestion, collections and datasets, quality controls, downloads, digitization, georeferencing, licenses, citations, source code, and institutional context.
purpose.authoritative_notice: iDigBio, its participating institutions, data publishers, source collections, TDWG standards, GBIF publishing tools, and cited repositories remain authoritative for records, media, schemas, APIs, licenses, versions, and contacts.
